en: A vintage illustrated postcard showing a stout man sitting indoors and knitting a long stocking. The drawing is somewhat cartoonish, with the man seated on a simple chair, a brick wall and a small window behind him. To the right is a cupboard or shelving unit with various items and a teapot. Danish text is printed above and below the illustration, including a title about the 'Adler' man and additional promotional or humorous text.
